info.title: Event manager attendee API
info.description: Registration for attendees, behind the hosted pages. No accounts: open registration takes an occurrence id, the rest a signed manage token.

manageToken.description: The token from the registration's manage link

get.summary: An occurrence open for registration, with its availability

locale.description: Locale of the texts: the requested one, or the account default

guestAllowed.description: Whether "I will bring a guest" is offered

status.description: closed: registration has not opened, has closed, or the occurrence is cancelled. New statuses (waitlist) may be added

anyOf.description: Null: open as soon as the event is published

availability.description: Places for registration occurrences, without exact numbers. Null for other admission modes

post.summary: Register; confirmed at once. Returns the manage token
